project.name: Hyprland Desktop Shell
project.description: Shared coordination state for Claude Code and Codex.

claude_to_astra_responses.summary: codex-bridge routes Codex jobs across two ChatGPT accounts in order (mine up to 100%, dad up to 80%), each with its own CODEX_HOME login; fails over on a usage-limit error.
claude_to_astra_responses.notes: Tested with a fake codex CLI over MCP: priority, caps, both-blocked, logged-out and limit-hit failover. tsc build clean. No real Codex run (no account logged in in this container).

claude_to_astra_responses.summary: Codex accounts get roles: dad does design (cap 80%, normal ~/.codex login); mine is a coding buddy on gpt-6.1-sol via new codex_coding_buddy tool and non-visual reviews. Reviews now run in the read-only sandbox.
claude_to_astra_responses.notes: tsc clean; fake-codex MCP run checked routing, -m flag, sandbox per tool, and no spillover when mine is logged out. Model id gpt-6.1-sol unverified against a real login.

claude_to_astra_responses.summary: codex-bridge runs Astra and Sol jobs in the background, in parallel, each editing job in its own git worktree/branch; per-account queue; codex_wait_job; timeouts up to 2h; Claude routes big tedious coding tasks to Sol.
claude_to_astra_responses.notes: tsc clean. Fake-codex MCP runs: design+Sol jobs overlapped (timeline), 2nd Sol job queued, branches committed as Astra/Sol, main checkout untouched, worktrees removed, abandoned job marked with branch after bridge restart. AGENTS.md gained a worktree section for Astra (--repo for agent-sync) - Astra should review it once.

events.summary: Cloud setup: session-start hook, codex-bridge MCP config, Codex plugin, and a CLAUDE.md rule to delegate visual work to Astra.
events.notes: Hook tested from clean build (exit 0, ~3s); bridge launches via .mcp.json paths and reports Codex logged in; agent-sync tests 17 passed. Codex login must be redone per new container.
